title: Day Flight 48 Miles Helicopter Tour over Theme Parks & Downtown
includes: All taxes, fees and handling charges
Helicopter tour (duration based on option selected)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Arrival time: passengers must arrive 10 minutes prior to their scheduled departure.
A minimum of 2 people per booking is required

Reschedule/Cancellation Policy: A full refund or reschedule requires at least 24 hours in advance of the start date of the experience. No refunds will be given after that time period. Although all flight times are approximate and subject to change due to weather conditions and weight restrictions. If it is cancelled due to inclement weather (heavy rain, low cloud ceilings, lightning, or extreme winds), you will be offered a different date or a full refund.
Infants up to 2 years old (under 30lb/14kg) must sit on a lap and will fly for free.
We require all the Adults' passengers IDs (drivers license or passports). No exception.
Weight restrictions: One person CANNOT exceed 300lbs (136kg/21.4st) and the total weight for 3 people is 600lbs (272kg/42.8st). All passengers must be willing to be weighed for safety.
policies: It is a private helicopter tour! You will not be sharing the helicopter with other tour passengers. Every seat is a window seat on this exciting Helicopter Tour!
Failure in showing up for your appointment without notice will result in cancellation of your tour without refund.
People per ride: The helicopter fits 3 passengers at a time so if you have a party of 4 people or more, we will have to split them in two or more rides.
If you have symptoms of fever or cough, you will not be able to fly. You must wear a mask during the tour.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Once you take off you will go over Aquatica, Epic Universe (new theme park), ICON Park, Orlando Eye, Universal Studios, Island of Adventures, Volcano Bay, then you will take quick detour to Downtown Orlando to see the cityscape, Camping World Stadium, KIA Center, and Lake Eola Park. On the return leg will be going over Disney Springs, Typhoon Lagoon, Blizzard Beach, Epcot (corner), Hollywood Studios, ESPN Sports Complex, Old Town, Fun Spot Kissimmee, and Give Kids the World Village. You may also catch a glimpse of Magic Kingdom and Animal Kingdom. 
It is a private helicopter tour! You will not be sharing the helicopter with other tour passengers. 
Every seat is a window seat on this exciting Helicopter Tour!
